record.question: Name the Indian badminton player who won the Indonesian Badminton Masters Grand Prix Gold on 14th September 2014?
record.explanation: The tournament sponsor's 19 September 2014 results report records Prannoy H.S. defeating Firman Abdul Kholik 21–11, 22–20 in the 14 September final. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.yonex.com/news/prannoy-wins-first-grand-prix-gold-title-at-yonex-sunrise-indonesian-masters/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
